title.narrative: Support to maintaining low HIV prevalence in Montenegro - Montenegro (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Montenegro, HIV, Ministry of Health of Montenegro (MoH Montenegro)This program has the following goals: Maintain low growth rate of HIV infection and universal multi-sector approach to prevention, treatment and support to persons living with HIV. The objectives of this program are: Creating a safe and supportive environment for people living with HIV and people in increased risk, and reduced gender inequality in response to HIV.. Establish an effective HIV and PPI prevention system among people in an increased risk, institutions and general population. Ensure affordable and equal treatment, care and assistance for all persons living with HIV.. Establish effective monitoring and monitoring that will enable the response to HIV/AIDS in line with current situation and needs. Creating sustainable coordination and partnership mechanisms in response to HIV/AIDS
